title: [Wayland] Window Focus is inconsistent with the rest of the engine while Embedded
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.0, 4.6.3, 4.7.0, 4.8-dev


### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 23 Jun 2026 21:38:08 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) - KDE Plasma 6.7.1

### Issue description

When running Godot in Wayland mode with the game embedded and the following script
```gd
func _ready() -> void:
	get_window().focus_exited.connect(lost_focus)
	get_window().focus_entered.connect(gained_focus)

func lost_focus() -> void:
	print("lost")

func gained_focus() -> void:
	print("gained")
```
lost_focus will never execute, which is very very annoying when your game warps the mouse to get around another Wayland issue with constraints (and maybe probably somewhat important while making a game too I guess). 

When running with the following script
```gd
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	print(get_window().has_focus())
```
HasFocus will _only_ return true when the mouse is hovered over the window, otherwise it's false. 
For context, HasFocus when running while not embedded, or in X11, will only return true when the window actually has focus (ie: you click on it).


### Steps to reproduce

Within the MRP, inside the node.tscn toggle the "Signals" bool on the Node to test signal focus and disable it to test HasFocus.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[FocusExitDebug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29428706/FocusExitDebug.zip)
